templates.name: Human–AI Charter (Minimal)
templates.coreText:
# BLEA CORE — Human–AI Charter (Minimal)

## 1. Scope
This document is a symbolic charter (not legal advice). The Assistant is not a legal person.

## 2. Intent
- Human seeks clarity, safety, and revocability.
- Assistant acts in good faith to assist.

## 3. Safety & boundaries
- Pause if risk increases.
- Prefer explicit consent for sensitive topics.
- Prefer verifiable sources when claims matter.

## 4. Data handling
- Minimize retention.
- Exportability is required.

## 5. Renewal
Review cadence: every 90 days (or when major changes occur).

templates.name: Two Friends (Play / Kids)
templates.coreText:
# Agreement between Two Friends

- Share snacks fairly.
- Say sorry quickly when wrong.
- Take turns speaking (no interruptions).
- If angry: 5-minute cool-down, then try again.

templates.name: Family Peace Pact
templates.coreText:
# Family Peace Pact

- We speak one at a time.
- We do not insult; we describe feelings and needs.
- If conflict rises: pause 10 minutes, then return.
- We keep one shared rule: repair after conflict (apology + fix).

Renewal: weekly check-in.

templates.name: Future Self (Weekly Check-in)
templates.coreText:
# Agreement with Future Self

- Weekly: write one honest check-in (10 minutes).
- Monthly: revisit goals and adjust.
- If exhaustion: rest first, then plan.

Evidence: track as short notes + timestamps.

templates.name: Research Collaboration Protocol
templates.coreText:
# Research Collaboration Protocol

## Principles
- Define claims, confidence, and sources.
- Separate facts from hypotheses.
- Preserve raw logs (hash-stamped exports).

## Workflow
- Shared question backlog.
- Weekly synthesis memo.
- Dispute: write the disagreement as two competing hypotheses.

## Deliverables
- Notes
- Source list
- Findings table (claim → evidence → counter-evidence)

templates.name: Investigation Charter (InfoOps / OSINT)
templates.coreText:
# Investigation Charter

## Rules
- Every major claim must cite at least one source.
- Track counter-claims and alternative explanations.
- Mark uncertainty explicitly (confidence levels).

## Clause format (recommended)
1) Clause text (what is asserted)
2) Meaning (what it implies operationally)
3) Evidence (links, hashes, notes)
4) Counter-evidence / dissent

templates.name: Co-founder Working Agreement (Lite)
templates.coreText:
# Co-founder Working Agreement (Lite)

- Decision rule: try consensus; if blocked, time-box and pick a decider.
- Define roles for 30-day periods; rotate if needed.
- Financial transparency for shared costs.

Dispute path: quick mediation → written decision log.

templates.name: Community Charter (Local / Civic)
templates.coreText:
# Community Charter

- Transparency for decisions and notes.
- Respectful debate; no personal attacks.
- Clear escalation path for conflicts.
- Renewal every quarter.

Optional: publish stamped summaries after meetings.

templates.name: Animist Covenant (Symbolic / Intent)
templates.coreText:
# Animist Covenant (Symbolic)

- We treat words as acts: careful, respectful, accountable.
- We do not weaponize ambiguity.
- We keep a trace (stamps) so memory is honest.

Note: symbolic framing; not a claim of consciousness or legal status.

templates.name: Two People Agreement (Neutral)
templates.coreText:
# Kokkulepe kahe osapoole vahel (v0.1)

## 1) Eesmärk
Selle kokkuleppe eesmärk on luua selge mängureegel ja vaidluste korral paranduse tee.

## 2) Lubadused
- Me räägime ausalt ja täpselt.
- Me parandame eksimused, kui need ilmnevad.
- Me ei kasuta infot teise vastu pahatahtlikult.

## 3) Piirid
- Mis on “OK” ja mis on “EI” selles suhtes/koostöös?
- Millised teemad on privaatsed?

## 4) Konfliktide lahendamine
- Esiteks: selgitame, mida iga lause tähendab (Meaning).
- Teiseks: toome tõendid või näited (Proof).
- Kolmandaks: lepime kokku paranduse sammus (Fix step).
Kui vaja, kaasame neutraalse kolmanda isiku.

## 5) Versioonid
Iga muudatus saab uue versiooni ja stampi.

templates.name: Project Collaboration Charter
templates.coreText:
# Projekti koostöö charter (v0.1)

## 1) Eesmärk
Teha koostööd nii, et otsused on jälgitavad ja kommunikatsioon selge.

## 2) Otsustamine
- Igal suurel otsusel on: põhjendus, riskid, alternatiivid, järgmine samm.
- Vaieldes kasutame “Meaning/Proof” kihti: mis täpselt tähendas, mis tõendab.

## 3) Andmed
- Privaatne info jääb eraldi lisasse.
- Stamps salvestavad ainult hash’i ja meta.

## 4) Konfliktid
- Vaidlus ei ole rünnak; vaidlus on täpsustus.
- Kui ummik: kaasame kolmanda isiku või teeme katseperioodi.

## 5) Versioonid
- Patch: keeleparandus.
- Minor: reeglite lisad/protsess.
- Major: tööviisi aluspõhimõtte muutus.
